# READ001: unreadable-file

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | READ |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | warn |

| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A walked file could not be read, so no rule examined it.

Raised as a required Unresolved finding for every file the walk includes
but the analysis cannot read: content that is not UTF-8, a permission
failure or any other read error, or a file over `[check] size_cap`. Such a
file must never look clean. Fix the encoding or permissions, raise
`size_cap`, or list the file under `[check] exclude` when it is binary or
generated; an excluded file is never walked, read or reported.

## Examples

### READ001 unreadable file / A file over the size cap fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
=== frob.toml
[check]
size_cap = 64
=== docs/big.md
# Big

This file is well over the sixty-four byte cap set above, so it is skipped.
```

### READ001 unreadable file / A file under the cap is clean #2 (line 20) (clean)

```text
=== frob.toml
[check]
size_cap = 4096
=== docs/small.md
# Small

Fits.
```
